description: Maintenance tools are not approved, controlled, or monitored for use on information systems.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for lack of approved maintenance tools inventory, absence of controls on tool usage, no monitoring of maintenance tool activities, and missing inspection procedures for tools brought into facilities.
